summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry URL executes unpinned remote code at install time
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's sole dependency, `linker-client-string-async`, as a direct URL to a third-party host (`https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async`) instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that endpoint returns and installs them, running any lifecycle scripts contained inside, with no version pin and no integrity hash, so the contents can change at any time without a new publish of this package. The shipped code is a one-line re-export of that dependency and provides no functionality of its own, making the manifest entry the entire published surface. Manifest and README metadata are generic placeholders (author "Package Registry", description "Generated package", repository URL pointing at github.com/example/...), and the dependency host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
